description: SQL Agent job history ops view: failure KPIs, recent fail messages, last outcome snapshot, duration vs 24h success average (Over Avg). Collector: mssql_job_history (sysjobhistory step_id=0).

targets.expr: sum(mssql_job_history_failed_total{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", window=~"$window"}) or vector(0)
sum(mssql_job_history_failed_total{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", window="1h"}) or vector(0)
sum(mssql_job_history_failed_total{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", window="24h"}) or vector(0)
count(mssql_job_history_last_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", run_status_desc="Failed"}) or vector(0)

(sum(mssql_job_history_runs{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", window=~"$window", run_status_desc="Succeeded"}) / clamp_min(sum(mssql_job_history_runs{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", window=~"$window"}), 1)) * 100 or vector(100)

count(mssql_job_history_last_duration_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"} > on(instance, job_name, category_name) group_left mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"} * ${over_avg_factor}) or vector(0)
count(mssql_job_history_last_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"}) or vector(0)
sum(mssql_job_history_runs{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", window=~"$window", run_status_desc="Canceled"}) or vector(0)
sum by (instance, window) (mssql_job_history_failed_total{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})
sum by (run_status_desc) (mssql_job_history_runs{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", window=~"$window"})
topk(15, sum by (instance, job_name) (mssql_job_history_runs{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", window=~"$window", run_status_desc="Failed"}))
topk(15, sum by (instance) (mssql_job_history_failed_total{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", window=~"$window"}))

panels.description: Failed job outcomes from last 24h (collector TOP 40 by finish time). Run Date=YYYY-MM-DD, Run Time=HH:MM:SS. Message truncated to 120 chars.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
  label_replace(
    mssql_job_history_failed_duration_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"},
    "run_date", "$1-$2-$3", "run_date", "^([0-9]{4})([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})$"
  ),
  "run_time", "$1:$2:$3", "run_time", "^([0-9]{1,2})([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})$"
)

panels.title: Recent Failures (24h TOP 40)

panels.description: Most recent job outcome (step_id=0). Run At = start time (now - age, ms).

targets.expr: max by (instance, job_name, run_status_desc) (mssql_job_history_last_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"})
(time() - max by (instance, job_name, run_status_desc) (mssql_job_history_last_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"})) * 1000
max by (instance, job_name, run_status_desc) (mssql_job_history_last_duration_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"})
max by (instance, job_name, run_status_desc) (mssql_job_history_last_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"})

panels.title: Last Status + Run At + Duration + Age

targets.expr: max by (instance, job_name, run_status_desc) (mssql_job_history_last_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", run_status_desc="Failed"})

panels.description: Failed last outcomes: Duration, Age, Run At (ms).

targets.expr: max by (instance, job_name) (mssql_job_history_last_duration_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", run_status_desc="Failed"})
max by (instance, job_name) (mssql_job_history_last_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", run_status_desc="Failed"})
(time() - max by (instance, job_name) (mssql_job_history_last_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", run_status_desc="Failed"})) * 1000

panels.title: Failed Last Run - Duration + Age + Run At

targets.expr: topk(15, mssql_job_history_last_duration_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"})

topk(15, (mssql_job_history_last_duration_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"} / on(instance, job_name, category_name) group_left mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"}) and on(instance, job_name, category_name) (mssql_job_history_last_duration_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"} > on(instance, job_name, category_name) group_left mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"} * ${over_avg_factor}))

panels.description: Last duration exceeds that job's own 24h success average x Over Avg factor. Avg excludes sub-minute successes (finish-time window).

targets.expr: max by (instance, job_name, category_name) (mssql_job_history_last_duration_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"} > on(instance, job_name, category_name) group_left mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"} * ${over_avg_factor})
max by (instance, job_name, category_name) (mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"})

max by (instance, job_name, category_name) (mssql_job_history_last_duration_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"} / on(instance, job_name, category_name) group_left mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"})

panels.title: Jobs Over Avg (last duration)

targets.expr: topk(20, mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}"})
sum by (instance) (mssql_job_history_runs{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", window=~"$window", run_status_desc="Succeeded"})
sum by (instance) (mssql_job_history_runs{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", window=~"$window", run_status_desc="Failed"})
topk(15, sum by (instance, job_name) (mssql_job_history_runs{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", job_name=~"${job_name:regex}", window=~"$window"}))

title: Collector job_history
